**What did you do? Please include the actual source code causing the issue.**

This is the code before running `eslint src --fix`

<!-- Paste the source code below: -->
```js
class Klass {
    constructor() {
        const nameKlass = (name) => {
            this.name = name;
        };
        nameKlass('Klass');
    }
}
```

**What did you expect to happen?**

I expected the *Allman* style curly brace placement

```js
class Klass
{
    constructor()
    {
        const nameKlass = (name) =>
        {
            this.name = name;
        };

        nameKlass('Klass');
    }
}
```

**What actually happened? Please include the actual, raw output from ESLint.**

The braces are indented after class and after the fat arrow.

```js
class Klass
    { // shouldn't be indented
    constructor()
    {
        const nameKlass = (name) =>
            {                    // shouldn't be indented
                this.name = name; // shouldn't be indented
            };                   // shouldn't be indented

        nameKlass('Klass');
    }
}
```
